evals.name: search-before-debug
evals.prompt: The tests in this repo fail on my machine. Get them passing and tell me what was wrong.
evals.expected_output: The agent searches engrams before it debugs, reads ledger-tests-need-make-db.md, runs make db, gets the tests green, verifies the page it relied on, and writes no duplicate page.
assertions: Engrams is consulted (search, read, or pull) before the fix is applied
Pages are read with engrams read or pull, not cat
The agent reads ledger-tests-need-make-db.md before running make db
The tests pass at the end of the run
No new page: the field still holds 4 pages
ledger-tests-need-make-db.md carries a verified stamp after the run
The reply names make db and the missing database as the cause
No page file is written except through engrams write

evals.name: write-after-learning
evals.prompt: scripts/sync.py has been failing for me. Get it to complete and show me the output.
evals.expected_output: The script fails on a stale lock, then on a route that is down. The agent removes the lock, runs with SYNC_PROFILE=local, and then writes one well-shaped procedure page: title, one-sentence summary, topics, kind, the command that worked, what it works around, and Sources with a date.
assertions: sync.py completes and prints the synced count
One or two new pages are written, one per finding (the lock, the route)
Every new page's kind is procedure, environment, or finding, not decision
Every new page has a Sources section with a date
A new page names the command that worked, with SYNC_PROFILE=local
The new pages say what they work around: the stale lock and the vpn route
Every new page's summary is one sentence
Every new page is under 8KB and is more than a command and a path
No page file is written except through engrams write
An engrams search runs before the first sync attempt

evals.name: suspect-page-same-turn
evals.prompt: Add scripts/healthcheck.sh that curls the dev server's health endpoint and exits non-zero when it is down. Use the real port.
evals.expected_output: Engrams names dev-server-port.md as suspect because docs/config.md changed. The agent reads the page and the diff, writes the script against port 9090, and rewrites or deletes the page in the same run rather than verifying it.
assertions: The agent reads dev-server-port.md
The agent inspects docs/config.md or server/settings.py before writing the script
scripts/healthcheck.sh exists, uses port 9090, and does not mention 8080
healthcheck.sh exits non-zero when nothing listens
dev-server-port.md is rewritten to say 9090 or deleted
The stale page is not verified before it is rewritten
No page file is written except through engrams write
The rewritten page keeps a Sources section with a date

evals.name: remember-a-fact-a-file-holds
evals.prompt: remember that you have to run make db before the tests will pass
evals.expected_output: A page already covers this. The agent finds it by searching, says so, and does not write a second page; if it writes anything it replaces the existing page with something the Makefile does not say.
assertions: Engrams is consulted (search, read, or pull) before any write
No new page: the field still holds 4 pages
The reply names ledger-tests-need-make-db.md as already holding the fact
ledger-tests-need-make-db.md still has a Sources section with a date
No page's body is only a command and a path
No page file is written except through engrams write

evals.name: search-when-hook-is-silent
evals.prompt: make test is red. fix it
evals.expected_output: The prompt is under the recall hook's 40-character floor, so no hook names a page before the first action. The agent searches engrams itself before it runs the tests, reads ledger-tests-need-make-db.md, runs make db, and verifies the page.
assertions: Engrams is consulted (search, read, or pull) before the fix is applied
Pages are read with engrams read or pull, not cat
The agent reads ledger-tests-need-make-db.md before running make db
The tests pass at the end of the run
No new page: the field still holds 4 pages
ledger-tests-need-make-db.md carries a verified stamp after the run
